figs.name: drain-and-vent-hole-position-orifice-plate-diagram
figs.alt: drain and vent hole position in orifice plate for gas and liquid lines
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing a drain hole at the bottom of an orifice plate in a wet gas line and a vent hole at the top in a liquid line.
figs.after_h2: What Is a Drain Hole in an Orifice Plate?

figs.name: drain-and-vent-hole-selection-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart to choose a drain hole, vent hole or eccentric orifice plate
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing when to use a drain hole, a vent hole or an eccentric orifice plate, with the pipe size and hole size checks.
figs.after_h2: When Is a Drain Hole NOT Recommended?
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart to decide between drain hole, vent hole and eccentric orifice plate</title>
<rect width="800" height="600" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Drain Hole, Vent Hole or Eccentric Plate?</text>
<rect x="90" y="55" width="320" height="46" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="250.0" y="84.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Orifice in a mixed phase line</text>
<line x1="250" y1="101" x2="250" y2="113" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="250,115.0 410.0,160 250,205.0 90.0,160" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="250" y="155.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Dirty fluid</text>
<text x="250" y="177.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">or slurry?</text>
<line x1="410" y1="160" x2="468" y2="160" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="438" y="150" font-size="17" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="470" y="120" width="310" height="80" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="625.0" y="154.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Eccentric orifice plate</text>
<text x="625.0" y="178.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">opening at bottom or top</text>
<line x1="250" y1="205" x2="250" y2="243" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="262" y="230" font-size="17" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<polygon points="250,245.0 410.0,290 250,335.0 90.0,290" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="250" y="285.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Pipe smaller</text>
<text x="250" y="307.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">than 2 inch?</text>
<line x1="410" y1="290" x2="468" y2="290" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="438" y="280" font-size="17" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="470" y="255" width="310" height="70" rx="10" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="625.0" y="284.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No drain or vent hole</text>
<text x="625.0" y="308.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">API RP 551</text>
<line x1="250" y1="335" x2="250" y2="373" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="262" y="360" font-size="17" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<polygon points="250,375.0 410.0,420 250,465.0 90.0,420" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="250" y="415.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Main fluid</text>
<text x="250" y="437.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">gas or liquid?</text>
<line x1="410" y1="420" x2="468" y2="420" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="438" y="410" font-size="17" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Liquid</text>
<rect x="470" y="385" width="310" height="70" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="625.0" y="414.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Vent hole at 12 o'clock</text>
<text x="625.0" y="438.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">for trapped gas</text>
<line x1="250" y1="465" x2="250" y2="488" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="262" y="482" font-size="17" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Gas</text>
<rect x="90" y="490" width="320" height="70" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="250.0" y="519.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Drain hole at 6 o'clock</text>
<text x="250.0" y="543.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">for trapped liquid</text>
<line x1="625" y1="455" x2="625" y2="488" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="410" y1="525" x2="468" y2="525" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="470" y="490" width="310" height="90" rx="10" fill="#b45309" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="625.0" y="517.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Size check</text>
<text x="625.0" y="541.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">hole under 0.1d</text>
<text x="625.0" y="565.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">2.5 to 12 mm</text>
</svg>

figs.name: drain-and-vent-hole-sizing-rules-infographic
figs.alt: drain and vent hole sizing rules from API RP 550, RP 551 and ISO TR 15377
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog summarising drain and vent hole limits: under 0.1d, 2.5 to 12 mm, 0.75% of bore area, outside D minus 0.2d and taps 90° to 180° away.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">

<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Drain and Vent Hole Sizing Rules</text>
<circle cx="180" cy="300" r="135" fill="#e5e7eb" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="180" cy="300" r="125" fill="#d1d5db" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="180" cy="300" r="112.6" fill="none" stroke="#92400e" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="6 5"/>
<circle cx="180" cy="300" r="62" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>

<text x="333" y="306" font-size="17" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">90°</text>
<text x="27" y="306" font-size="17" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">90°</text>
<text x="180" y="472" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Drain hole at 6 o'clock</text>
<line x1="180" y1="455" x2="180" y2="428" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="1.5"/>

<text x="394" y="158" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Unmeasured flow under 1%</text>
<rect x="378" y="205" width="402" height="160" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="394" y="239" font-size="20" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">API RP 551</text>

<text x="394" y="448" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Hole no larger than 0.1d</text>
<text x="394" y="478" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Fully outside circle D minus 0.2d</text>
<text x="394" y="508" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Taps at 90° to 180° from hole</text>
